name: tw_overrides
description: Literal Taiwan-usage overrides applied on top of OpenCC s2twp (Simplified -> Traditional, Taiwan phrases). Keys are Simplified source text; values are the FINAL Traditional output and must be emitted literally (never re-fed through OpenCC). Longest key wins. Scope rules (chapter text only, never metadata; 天蚕土豆 guard) live in code, not here. See docs/shared-overrides.md.
